orchestra:
instr 811
  ; Cinema air: ventilation, room distance, a tiny, unpitched electrical memory.
  aNoise rand .27
  aBand butterlp aNoise,1000
  aBand butterhp aBand,63
  aHiss rand .12
  aHiss butterhp aHiss,3100
  aHiss butterlp aHiss,7800
  kBreath lfo .19,.083,0
  kFade linseg 0,1,1,14,1,1,0
  aLeft = (aBand*(.43+kBreath)+aHiss*.06)*kFade*.58
  aRight = (aBand*(.38-kBreath*.5)+aHiss*.052)*kFade*.58
  outs aLeft,aRight
endin
instr 812
  ; Soft film dust: irregular colored broadband texture, no cadence or tones.
  aCrackle rand .24
  aCrackle butterhp aCrackle,550
  aCrackle butterlp aCrackle,5200
  kSway lfo .15,.071,0
  kFade linseg 0,1.5,1,13,1,1.5,0
  outs aCrackle*(.31+kSway)*kFade*.45,aCrackle*(.29-kSway)*kFade*.44
endin

giwave ftgen 8201,0,16384,10,1,.18,.06,.017
gisine ftgen 8202,0,16384,10,1

instr 821
  ; A soft struck bar with jazz-like shimmer and nonharmonic partials.
  iHz cpsmidinn p4
  iAmp=p5
  aEnv expseg .001,.009,1,p3-.009,.0005
  a1 oscili .24,iHz,8201
  a2 oscili .075,iHz*2.008,8202
  a3 oscili .034,iHz*3.937,8202
  a4 oscili .017,iHz*.503,8202
  kSway lfo .007,.62
  aMix=(a1+a2+a3+a4)*aEnv*iAmp
  aMix butterlp aMix,2800
  outs aMix*(.92+kSway), aMix*(.85-kSway)
endin

instr 822
  ; Muted single low string: a few breaths, not a repeating bassline.
  iHz cpsmidinn p4
  iAmp=p5
  aBody oscili .20,iHz,8201
  aOct oscili .09,iHz*.5,8202
  aEnv linseg 0,.025,1,.13,.67,p3-.155,0
  aLow butterlp (aBody+aOct)*aEnv,520
  outs aLow*iAmp,aLow*iAmp
endin

instr 823
  ; Finger-brush texture (not a backbeat): short high colored noise.
  aNoise rand .13
  aNoise butterhp aNoise,2700
  aNoise butterlp aNoise,7400
  aEnv linen 1,.03,p3,.22
  outs aNoise*aEnv*p4*.78,aNoise*aEnv*p4*.61
endin

instr 824
  ; Exhaled hollow tone with tiny analogue detuning.
  iHz cpsmidinn p4
  aA oscili .09,iHz,8201
  aB oscili .045,iHz*1.004,8202
  aNoise rand .004
  aEnv linseg 0,.18,.8,p3-.85,.65,.67,0
  aTone butterlp (aA+aB+aNoise)*aEnv,1450
  outs aTone*p5*.82,aTone*p5*.90
endin

instr 825
  ; Deliberate end-to-end fade so repeated excerpts never click.
  ; The main recording envelope is rendered here, not in the authoring source.
  aInL,aInR monitor
endin
label: Cinematic memory synthesizer — live original Csound voices
fidelity: Live synthesis of original Kino air, film-dust and Midnight Cylinder; instrument voices preserved, score assembled for this audition
